weapons.name: Stun Bomb
weapons.desc: Drops a room's defenders to the floor right before your boarders land.

weapons.name: Knockout Gas Bomb
weapons.desc: Fills a room with gas. Hurts everyone inside, so beam your crew out first.

drones.name: Bouncer Drone
drones.desc: A cheap anti-boarder drone that patrols your corridors.

augments.name: Grapnel Boots
augments.desc: Your crew move 15% faster and hit 10% harder.

augments.name: Trauma Kits
augments.desc: Your crew slowly heal anywhere aboard, even in a fight.

ships.name: The Crowbar
ships.desc: Built to open other ships. A big teleporter, a big medbay and a crew of brawlers.

ships.name: The Can Opener
ships.desc: Sends drones over first. Your crew follow once the defenders are busy.

events.text: A Mantlis fighting arena hangs between two moons. The champion is taking challengers: one bout, winner takes the purse.

success.text: Your fighter wins to a standing ovation. The purse is generous and the training was free.

fail.text: Your fighter loses, badly, but learns a lot.

success.text: {who} wins in four seconds. The crowd goes wild.

fail.text: {who} loses on points and sulks for a jump.

success.text: The champion wins. You double your money.

fail.text: The champion trips. You lose your bet.

events.text: Pyrates have taken over a mining station and are holding its workers hostage. The workers' families are offering everything they have.

effect.text: Your boarders storm the station. The pyrates' ship rushes to defend them.

afterWin.text: The workers are safe. One of them signs on with you.

effect.text: The pyrates leave with the scrap. A grateful worker joins your crew.
There are no authorities out here. You jump anyway.

events.text: A Fedoration marine outpost offers to run your crew through a boarding drill. "Free of charge. We need the practice too."

effect.text: Bruises all round, and everyone is better for it.
The quartermaster finds you some old gear.

events.text: A junk dealer has a pile of boarding drones "with only minor personality issues".

effect.text: It salutes you. Then it salutes the wall. Then it salutes you again.
It guards the airlock with great enthusiasm.
One of the drones follows you to the airlock, then gets bored.
